specifications.material: Body: cast steel; disc/stem: stainless steel; packing: graphite

usecase: Stop Valve (Globe) for Fuel Oil (F.O.) Filling & Transfer System.

troubleshooting.symptoms: Seat leakage, gland leakage, stiff handwheel, vibration/noise, unexpected pressure drop.
troubleshooting.possible_causes: Disc/seat wear, packing damage, deposits, bent stem, incorrect operation.
troubleshooting.diagnostic_steps: Check valve position, inspect bonnet and gland, verify smooth travel, compare upstream/downstream readings.
troubleshooting.immediate_action: Notify engineer, do not tighten or dismantle under pressure, follow approved isolation procedure.
troubleshooting.operational_impact: Reduced flow, Pressure loss Confirm no leakage, verify correct valve position, check line pressure/flow stability, obtain engineer acceptance after
troubleshooting.prevention_measures: Inspect packing and seating surfaces, operate smoothly, maintain per maker recommendations.

specifications.material: Body: carbon steel; ball: stainless steel; seat: PTFE

usecase: Ball Valve for Fuel Oil (F.O.) Filling & Transfer System.

troubleshooting.symptoms: Leakage through closed valve, stem/body leakage, stiff lever, incomplete quarter-turn, restricted flow.
troubleshooting.possible_causes: Damaged PTFE seat, debris in ball cavity, worn stem seal, corrosion, incorrect end-stop. Confirm lever/position indicator, inspect stem and body, check for external leakage, compare line pressure and flow
troubleshooting.immediate_action: Notify engineer, do not dismantle under pressure, isolate and make safe before maintenance.
troubleshooting.operational_impact: Reduced flow, Pressure loss Confirm no leakage, verify correct valve position, check line pressure/flow stability, obtain engineer acceptance after
troubleshooting.verification_steps: maintenance. Keep clean, inspect seat and stem seals, operate through full travel when permitted, follow maker maintenance

troubleshooting.symptoms: Valve passing when closed, handwheel hard to turn, stem leakage, high pressure drop when open.
troubleshooting.possible_causes: Wedge or seat wear, deposits, stem/nut wear, packing deterioration, corrosion. Verify fully open/closed indication, inspect stem and gland, check travel without excessive force, compare line
troubleshooting.immediate_action: Do not force handwheel or use as a throttling valve, inform engineer and isolate/depressurize before repair.
troubleshooting.operational_impact: Reduced flow, Pressure loss Confirm no leakage, verify correct valve position, check line pressure/flow stability, obtain engineer acceptance after
troubleshooting.prevention_measures: Maintain stem and packing, avoid prolonged throttling, inspect and exercise periodically when permitted.
